The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the eighteenth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[S18|Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest]], in {{pmin|Australia}} and {{pmin|New Zealand}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 4}}). ==Partial collections== Two Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest Collections were released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in 2015 and 2016, containing the whole season between them. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning. ===Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest - Collection 1=== [[File:XY Kalos Quest Collection 1.png|thumb|Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest - Collection 1]] Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest - Collection 1 was released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia on November 4, 2015 and in New Zealand on November 18, 2015. It contains three discs with 22 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE6410. ====Contents==== {| class="roundy" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Kalos}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Kalos}}" !
